rows.name: crowdy.entity.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyReplication entity activity: registry add/remove, event routing and dispatch, entity components, and actor tracking/management. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.exec.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs Server Object activity: status changes, applied reads and pushes with their epoch and seq, re-reads, subscribes, calls and the connection. Never values or tokens. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.hud.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyServices HUD activity: HUD base and widgets. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.anim.trace
rows.help: Log every animation sequence index the Crowdy animation processor writes, per entity.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.neartier.trace
rows.help: Say when a crowd entity gains a near tier actor, whether that actor was built or taken from the pool, and when it goes back. 1 on, 0 off.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.nodes.trace
rows.help: Log where the Call Crowdy Event on Entity dropdown's entries came from (0 = off, 1 = on).

rows.name: crowdy.net.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyNet UDP transport activity: socket open/close, message sends and receives, worker-thread pool, and buffer pool churn. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.pool.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyReplication actor-pool activity: spawn, release, reuse, and rendering-backend churn. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.query.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyNet GraphQL activity: query dispatch and responses. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.rpc.reliable.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs just the reliable (channel-transport) RPC path: a Multicast CrowdyEvent's channel send and the matching receive on every member. Narrower than crowdy.rpc.trace, which covers all RPC sends and receives; either one surfaces the reliable lines.

rows.name: crowdy.rpc.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs every CrowdyEvent RPC send and receive: function, entity, addressing, owned/delegated classification, and parameter byte size.

rows.name: crowdy.sdk.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs top-level CrowdySDK activity: subsystem lifecycle and configuration / gameplay-tag path registration. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.serialize.scopes
rows.help: When non-zero, emits the fine-grained CPU trace scopes inside payload decode. Each one costs two timestamps per received message and is nested inside a scope that is itself measured, so it is off by default and a reading must say whether the run carried it.

rows.name: crowdy.serialize.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyNet payload serialization: message encode/decode and payload/class registry resolves. High frequency, so off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.services.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyServices activity: authentication, teams, avatars, persistence, host subsystem, utilities, and Blueprint reception. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.state.scopes
rows.help: When non-zero, emits a CPU trace scope around each CrowdyState delta decode. Nested inside the enclosing delivery scope, so it shifts that scope's own figure: turn it on only for a run that needs the split. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.state.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyReplication CrowdyState replicator activity: owned-entity diffing, delta emission, and datagram sizes. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.studio.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs each CrowdyStudio console GraphQL op: its plane, operation name, and outcome (HTTP code, error count). The bearer token is never logged. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.voice.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyVoice activity: voice chat subsystem, capture/playback service, and audio device monitoring. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.kit.emotes.burst
rows.help: How many inbound emotes may arrive at once before the per-second budget applies (default 16).

rows.name: crowdy.kit.emotes.maxpersecond
rows.help: How many inbound emotes per second are read, shared by every sender (default 64). Emotes over the budget are dropped before they are parsed.

rows.name: crowdy.kit.emotes.persender.burst
rows.help: How many inbound emotes one sender may send at once before its per-second budget applies (default 4).

rows.name: crowdy.kit.emotes.persender.maxpersecond
rows.help: How many inbound emotes per second are read from one sender (default 4). The shared budget still caps all senders together.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.anim.dump
rows.help: While set to 1, log a summary of the animation sets in use and of the instance batches handed to each instanced skinned mesh component, once per second. Set back to 0 to stop.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.anim.force
rows.help: Force this animation bank sequence index on every Mass entity the Crowdy animation processor sees. A negative value disables forcing, which is the default.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.anim.releasefromobserver
rows.help: Release an entity's renderer visual straight from the destruction observer instead of deferring it to the next frame. This is the behaviour the deferral replaced and it leaks an animation track per entity destroyed mid-frame. It exists so the animation track gate can be proven to fail. 0 is correct behaviour and the default.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.derive.force
rows.help: Spawn every remote entity from a Mass entity config built out of its own class, pushing aside the per-class binding, the backend override and the project-wide Remote Entity Config. 1 on, 0 off. The class's animation set is pushed aside with it, so the entity animates from the set and the Bank the class itself declares, and an entity that appears in bind pose under this is showing what an unconfigured class carries. Entities already spawned keep the config they were built from; every class's animation answer is worked out again.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.event.proxy
rows.help: Run an inbound event's own body on a per-class stand-in for entities held here as rows. 1 on, 0 off. Off, an event nothing registered a handler for lands nothing beyond the action write a declared action gets, which is what this client did before the stand-in existed.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.interp.adaptive
rows.help: Replay each remote segment over the observed arrival interval. 1 on, 0 off (fixed duration), -1 to follow the project setting.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.interp.max
rows.help: Longest span a remote segment may be replayed over, in seconds. Negative to follow the project setting.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.interp.min
rows.help: Shortest span a remote segment may be replayed over, in seconds. Negative to follow the project setting.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.interp.overshoot
rows.help: How much longer than the observed arrival interval a remote segment is replayed over. Negative to follow the project setting.

rows.name: crowdy.net.http2
rows.help: Asks for HTTP/2 on the SDK's own requests, falling back to HTTP/1.1 when the server does not offer it; 0 leaves the engine's HTTP version. With HTTP/2 the curl diagnostics the engine logs for a failed request can include the request headers, bearer token included, so set 0 if you ship logs from builds with logging enabled.

rows.name: crowdy.net.receive.poolactorupdates
rows.help: Reuse actor update message objects instead of allocating one per received message (default 1). Turn it off to measure what the pool is worth on the same build.

rows.name: crowdy.net.retry.busy
rows.help: Sends an SDK query, a password sign-in or an app-token mint or refresh again, up to 3 times with backoff, when the platform refuses it and says to retry (blame PLATFORM, retryable). 0 hands every refusal straight to the caller.

rows.name: crowdy.rpc.allowObjectLoad
rows.help: When non-zero, a received object or class reference whose asset is not already resident is loaded from disk by path. Default 0 (find-only) so an untrusted peer cannot trigger arbitrary asset loads; an unresolved reference is delivered as null.

rows.name: crowdy.rpc.loopback
rows.help: When non-zero, a sent replicated CrowdyEvent is also delivered to this client's own receive path, so the whole serialize/resolve/dispatch round-trip can be tested without a second client. The call runs once locally through that path; a call made from the replayed body is sent normally but does not loop back, so there is no cascade.

rows.name: crowdy.state.loopback
rows.help: When non-zero, a sent CrowdyState delta for an owned entity is also decoded onto a local 'mirror' entity (a lazily-spawned second instance of the same class, RemoteProxy role, a distinct NetID) so decode/OnRep/host-authority checks can be exercised from one PIE client. Unlike crowdy.rpc.loopback this cannot replay onto the same actor (an owner's own entity silently drops a non-host-sourced delta, and decode's changed-detection would report no change against identical values); the mirror is a genuinely distinct receive target instead.

rows.name: crowdy.auth.consent.preview
rows.help: Shows the consent prompt over the game viewport without recording anything; Accept and Decline only close it.

rows.name: crowdy.auth.signin.file
rows.help: Signs in with the password account in a JSON file, {"email": "...", "password": "..."}, for headless smoke tests. For test accounts and development builds only: the password sits in that file, so keep it out of source control. Never type a password as a console argument, which the console logs. Args: <path to the file>.

rows.name: crowdy.auth.signout
rows.help: Signs the player out through the SDK's normal logout.

rows.name: crowdy.auth.status
rows.help: Prints whether this game instance is signed in, the user id, whether the app token is set and when it expires, and whether the app is paused. Never prints a token.

rows.name: crowdy.cpp.selftest
rows.help: Link + exception-containment self test for the vendored CrowdyCPP library.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.crowdsim.profile
rows.help: crowdy.mass.crowdsim.profile

rows.name: crowdy.mass.crowdsim.start
rows.help: Crowd simulation: emit position updates for N simulated players through the real send path. Args: [count] [radiusMetres] [class].crowdy.mass.crowdsim.start

rows.name: crowdy.mass.crowdsim.status
rows.help: Crowd simulation: report the rate actually achieved, what the simulated players are doing, and how they are spread over chunks.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.crowdsim.stop
rows.help: Crowd simulation: stop emitting. The simulated players are left to the tracker's normal timeout.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.derive
rows.help: Says what a Mass entity config derived from an actor class would contain, without spawning anything. Args: <class>, a short name, an asset path or a full object path.Usage: crowdy.mass.derive <class>, a short name, an asset path or a full object path.crowdy.mass.derive:

rows.name: crowdy.mass.gates
rows.help: Runs every automated gate and prints one PASS/FAIL report to copy in a single selection: the one-shot action path, the view-state echo (a pose landing, a second echo changing it, a pose touching nothing else, a pose clearing, a hostile echo in every field being unable to unmake an entity, a truncated payload, a forged payload), the renderer's animation track count across a spawn and destroy churn, whether every authored pose resolves to a bank slot of its own, the CrowdyState delta path into an entity that owns no participant (which road actually wrote the pose, what was dropped, and whether a field registered from outside this module receives its bytes), and any gate a game has registered. Optional arg: how many entities the churn spawns (default 64, clamped 1 to 1024). Around fifteen seconds at the default; forces crowdy.rpc.loopback on for the run and restores it afterwards.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.gates.stop
rows.help: Abandons a gate run in progress, destroying its entities and restoring crowdy.rpc.loopback.

rows.name: crowdy.mass.oneshot
rows.help: Fires one PlayOneShot at a Mass entity along the camera's aim, or at any tracked one. Args: <actionId> [variant] [playRate].

rows.name: crowdy.mass.proxyprobe
rows.help: Builds a never-spawned dispatch proxy of a class and reports what is real on it: which components exist, which are registered, whether a body would be allowed to run, and what only a genuinely spawned actor has. Args: <ClassPathOrName> [FunctionName] [SpawnComparison 0|1, default 1]. The comparison spawns and immediately destroys one real actor of the class, which runs its construction script and its BeginPlay.[dispatch proxy probe]: name a class, for example crowdy.mass.proxyprobe /Game/Characters/BP_Hero.BP_Hero_C[dispatch proxy probe]: nothing loaded for '

rows.name: crowdy.mass.sendaction
rows.help: Sends the SDK's generic Crowdy action at a Mass entity along the camera's aim, or at any tracked one, through the real Send Crowdy Action path: it reaches every machine drawing the entity, this one included, and unlike crowdy.mass.oneshot it carries no ownership check. Args: <actionName> [variant] [playRate].

rows.name: crowdy.mass.state.verdict
rows.help: Print one block describing whether CrowdyState is reaching crowd entities: every replicated property no fragment field claims, deltas claimed and applied, every drop reason, and which road wrote the pose. Paste the whole block when reporting a gate.

rows.name: crowdy.net.routes
rows.help: Prints the network router's subscription table: every payload key and opcode, with the struct behind it where one is registered, and every subscriber by role.

rows.name: crowdy.registry.dump
rows.help: Logs every entry of the baked registry, one line each: persistent and singleton structs, layout hashes, CrowdyState properties and CrowdyEvent functions with their ids.

rows.name: crowdy.rpc.dumpfn
rows.help: Reports what a Crowdy event is in this process: resolved, replicated, its recipient, its FunctionID, and whether its compiled body carries the dispatch gate. Args: <ClassPathOrName> <FunctionName>. A Blueprint class name ends in _C.

rows.name: crowdy.state.heartbeat.advisories
rows.help: Lists every CrowdyState enum property this process found outside the keyframe heartbeat, and how many resolutions each one's single warning stands for.
